_comment: D3b forward falsifier-accuracy ledger (records/2026-11-03_profit_program_DRAFTS.md; calibration v2 Rule S). OPERATOR-EDITABLE. Each spec is a MACHINE-CHECKABLE encoding of a register falsifier (universe_register.json themes.<key>.falsifier), so the ledger can record, once per name, whether the falsifier fired on the first quarterly report it names, and later whether the name made its big move anyway. Telemetry only: a fired falsifier never sells, gates or vetoes anything. ENCODED BY CC 2026-11-03 FROM THE REGISTER TEXT; the operator confirms or edits. Only the revenue leg is encoded: FIG's 'or net dollar retention < 120%' and KKR's Aug-2027 standing review are not machine-checkable and are left out (recorded in 'not_encoded'). The qualitative falsifiers (nuclear_fuel, grid_equipment, copper_supply, space_smallcap, silver_deficit, seaborne_freight, refrigerant_transition, fiber_buildout, mrna_oncology, ag_cycle_trough) have no dated numeric test and are not encoded. metric 'quarterly_revenue_yoy' = single-quarter revenue vs the same quarter a year earlier, from SEC XBRL companyfacts (data/fundamentals.py REV_CONCEPTS), on the FIRST quarter filed strictly after first_filed_after. fired = value < threshold.

specs.source: Q3-2026 (reported ~Nov-2026) revenue growth < 30% y/y, or net dollar retention < 120%
The first quarterly report dated after 2026-09-13 shows quarterly revenue growth below +10% y/y.
The quarter reported after 2026-09-30 shows revenue growth below +10% y/y.
Quarterly revenue growth in the next 10-Q (quarter ending 2026-10-31, filed ~early December) falls below +20% y/y.
quarterly revenue YoY below 5.0% in the 2026-Q3 10-Q = thesis dead
